newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Dec 7.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Dec 7.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crush totalled 444,777 tonnes in the week ended December 7, bringing the crush so far this year to 38.985 million tonnes, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said.

This is ahead of the 37.389 million tonnes crushed at the same time last year. CANEGROWERS reported for crushing week 27 of the 1996 season that average commercial cane sugar (ccs) content was 12.33 percent for the week.
Australian sugar cane crush by region for the week ended December 7 as reported by CANEGROWERS in tonnes.
The 1995 crush started on June 13 and ended by December 30.
CCS = Commercial Cane Sugar (sugar content percent)-
